verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say code review supports a Pull Request workflow, and that reviewers can browse code online and leave review comments, which submitters can answer or act on by changing the code. The pack never mentions diff comparison or line-level inline comments next to code, and nothing hands-on corroborates them. missing for 10: explicit diff/compare view documentation, explicit inline line-level review comment documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of the PR review experience

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a pull request, compare diffs, and leave inline review comments alongside the code

citations.quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow. Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.
Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
